//: TYPE-CHECKS THE TESTS, which tsconfig.json cannot. Two overrides, both load-bearing. `noUncheckedIndexedAccess: false` — that one flag turned every `rows[0].name` after an asserted length into an error and accounted for 205 of the 206 raised by simply including these files; what survives is the class that matters, a fixture carrying a field the type no longer has or missing one it now requires. And `exclude: []` — `extends` inherits `exclude` too, and tsconfig.json excludes exactly these files, so without it the program was EMPTY and the pass exited 0 having checked nothing (measured: 0 files vs 332). Run through svelte-check rather than plain tsc: a test that imports a component imports a .svelte file, and tsc reports every one of those as a missing exported member.
//lib: ES2023, where the base config targets ES2022: the tests call `toSorted`, which is ES2023 and which Node 24 has at run time — so vitest was green while the type system said the method did not exist, and each call took its callback parameters down with it as implicit `any`. Raising it here rather than in the base config, because the SOURCE ships to browsers and its target is a deliberate floor; a test only ever runs on the pinned Node.
